subject: D-06 ACK K_HARD_MAX and APP_W 128
body:
TASK: D-06 ACK K_HARD vs K_HARD_MAX + MIG width
STATUS: CANDIDATE. Not MIG_PASS. Not BOARD_PASS.

K_HARD = loaded profile (runtime_profile.k_hard). K_HARD_MAX = compiled SPEAR slot ceiling, not a profile field. Profile K_HARD > K_HARD_MAX -> k_invalid, no clamp.
SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH stays 32. SPEAR range check is prof_active_id_max, not [31:24]==0.
COMMITTED_CORRUPT stays dest-integrity, not a fourth compaction state (C recover_state=3 not taken).
Generated native MIG: APP_DATA_WIDTH=128, ADDR_WIDTH=28, ECC=OFF. Path D:/FPGA/miggen. No architecture conflict. Not MIG_PASS.
